source_values.extracted: pulled from the case documents by extraction
source_values.drafted: proposed by the system or written by the lawyer; always reviewed and confirmed by the lawyer
source_values.case_intake: entered when the case is created or the report is issued
source_values.search_office: taken from the Sub-Registrar / IGR search
source_values.profile: the advocate's profile (name, place of signing)

review_levels.must_confirm: Legal judgement (opinion, marketability, adverse or critical remarks, tenure, SARFAESI enforceability, claims, permissions). Never auto-confirmed: a lawyer must explicitly confirm or write the value. No positive wording is drafted while the case has open red flags.
review_levels.glance: Factual checklist answer, letterhead, party or search detail that can be pre-filled from the extracted documents and shown for a quick lawyer check.

rules: A must_confirm field is never auto-confirmed: a lawyer must explicitly confirm or write its value.
The system must not draft "clear and marketable", "no adverse entry", "enforceable" or similar favourable wording for a must_confirm field while the case has open red flags.
A glance field may be pre-filled from extracted documents but is still shown to the lawyer for a quick check before the report is issued.
An unset field renders as empty text; no conclusion text is hard-coded in the template.

notes: Different form from the Flairnetic reports: a 39-line bank questionnaire table plus Income Tax, Companies Act and Agricultural Land investigation tables. Every answer cell is a field.
Table rows are fixed: the question text and numbering stay as in the bank form (the source numbers two rows '18').
documents_verified is a row loop (Sr. No. is the loop index); documents_pre_disbursement and documents_post_disbursement are paragraph loops inside the answer to the equitable-mortgage question.

The mortgage_creatable answer replaces the source sentence 'YES - Equitable Mortgage by Deposit of Title Deeds is possible.'; the following line 'The following documents shall be obtained ...' stays fixed.
The seven numbered certificate points (cert_*) and the closing 'I certify that ...' paragraph were fixed conclusion text in the source and are now fields, so no conclusion wording is hard-coded.
'Name of the Title Holder' (top table) uses mortgagor_name (the intending buyers); present_owner_names is the seller, asked in question 1.
Tax rows 6 and 22(a) both ask about tax: row 6 is property_tax_payment_status, row 22(a) is property_tax_paid_status.
The source search note reads 'receipt dated <number>'; the wording is kept and the number goes in search_receipt_number.
The narration had a blank paragraph between the last 'we find' lines; it was removed so chain_steps is one loop.
documents_examined (the 'I have examined the documents in detail' list) is a separate loop from documents_verified, because the two lists are worded differently in the source.
The signature block has an 'Adv. {{ advocate_name }}' line added under 'For Flairnetic Advocates' (the source had none).
open_questions: Letter number and date of the bank's instruction letter were blank placeholders in the source; kept as optional bank_letter_number / bank_letter_date.
Question 2 ('absolute, clear and marketable title') and the certificate paragraph are lawyer conclusions; the source answered 'Yes.' with no qualification.
